SELECT 
    refund_id,
    rrn,
    bill_id,
    amount_inr,
    trigger,
    requested_ts,
    completed_ts,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_ts - requested_ts))/60 AS minutes_to_complete
FROM payments.upi_refunds
WHERE requested_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND requested_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY minutes_to_complete DESC;

sql_calls.sql:
WITH upi_attempts AS (
  SELECT bill_id, attempt, till_status, ts
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE tender = 'UPI'
    AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
  ORDER BY bill_id, attempt
),
declined_then_retry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a1.bill_id
  FROM upi_attempts a1
  JOIN upi_attempts a2 ON a1.bill_id = a2.bill_id AND a2.attempt = a1.attempt + 1
  WHERE a1.till_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response')
    AND a2.till_status = 'approved'
)
SELECT count(*) as retry_count
FROM declined_then_retry;

WITH may_bills AS (
  SELECT bill_id, SUM(line_amount) AS bill_total
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-05-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-06-01'
  GROUP BY bill_id
),
june_bills AS (
  SELECT bill_id, SUM(line_amount) AS bill_total
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY bill_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT bill_total FROM may_bills
  UNION ALL
  SELECT bill_total FROM june_bills
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_bills,
  SUM(bill_total) AS total_revenue,
  AVG(bill_total) AS avg_bill_value
FROM combined;
